risk_note: RV2 (content client config API). GET /v1/config now delivers lkg_max_age_sec (config.lkg_max_age_sec, default 604800), bridge_disabled_methods (bridge.disabled_methods, default []), features.rank_platforms (derived from the material channel whitelist, empty today) and config_version; every 200 carries a strong ETag = first 32 hex of sha256 over the canonical data JSON (per-viewer parts included) and config_version equals it unquoted; If-None-Match with a weak match answers 304 without a body. Same-named config rows never show through. The F1-02c rule tests were relaxed by F1-02i (#681) and stay green. No funds, no writes. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
